caption: -Supporting moms through pregnancy, postpartum & beyond-Postpartum |Breastfeeding |BabyCare-Certified in Lactation, InfantCare & Postpartum Wellnesswww.mindfulmotherhood.in/breastfeeding-essentialsThat expensive lactation powder might not be the first thing your breastfeeding journey needs. 🤍When you’re worried about your milk supply, it’s natural to look for something that can help — a laddu, a special drink, a supplement, or a particular food. And there’s nothing wrong with nourishing yourself.But here’s the distinction every breastfeeding mother deserves to understand: Supporting a breastfeeding mother and increasing her milk supply are not the same thing.Milk production depends largely on how often and how effectively milk is removed from the breasts. So before spending money on another lactation product, look at the basics:🤍 Is your baby latching well?🤍 Is milk being transferred effectively?🤍 Is your baby feeding frequently enough?Because sometimes, what you need isn’t another product. It’s the right information and support. Breastfeeding isn’t built on magic ingredients. It’s built on biology. 🌿Save this for the days you feel tempted to try every milk-boosting product you see. And share it with a new mom who needs to hear this.What was the one miracle product you were told to try when you became a mom? Let’s talk about it in the comments! 👇#motherhood #babycare #postpartum
